scenes: There is ice on the equator. For now.
High on Puncak Jaya, in Papua, Indonesia, | sits Southeast Asia’s last tropical ice.
Ninety-nine per cent of its glacier area has gone since 1850. | What remains will very likely disappear around 2030.
What we lose, we can still slow elsewhere.
